name: noru-grc-engineering
description: Last-mile GRC pieces: do the compliance work that lives in your repo, CI or laptop, and land it in Noru with provenance, idempotency and a human review step.

plugins.name: noru
plugins.description: Hub for the Noru last-mile pieces: connect, doctor, and repository context shared by every piece.

plugins.name: ai-inventory
plugins.description: Scan a repository for the AI systems, model providers and oversight points it actually contains, review the manifest in a PR, and land it in Noru as assets, vendors and evidence.

plugins.name: governance-records
plugins.description: File the records of human decisions in Noru: minutes, ISMS scope, statement of applicability, internal audit plans and reports, findings and corrective action plans, each attributed and dated.

plugins.name: review-signoff
plugins.description: Turn a periodic review of machine output — access, rules, baselines, assets, physical access, vendors — into a named, dated, expiring sign-off in Noru.

plugins.name: evidence-push
plugins.description: Work Noru's own evidence queue: see which catalogue expectations are unmet, stage local artifacts against them, and upload with control mappings.
